text: Quickstart guide sets up a React app, indexes sample data, and builds a working search UI in minutes
quote: Set up a React app, index sample data in Algolia, and build a search interface with React InstantSearch.

text: Official CLI lets you work with Algolia APIs from the terminal for interactive use, scripts, and CI
quote: The Algolia CLI lets you work with Algolia's APIs from your terminal. It's great for interactive commands, scripts, and continuous integration workflows.

text: CLI can manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms
quote: `algolia-cli` Manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms via the Algolia CLI

text: Search API lets you search, configure, and manage indices and records programmatically
quote: The Algolia Search API lets you search, configure, and manage your indices and records

text: You can choose searchable attributes and apply custom ranking to tune relevance beyond text match
quote: Choose a good set of searchable attributes. Apply custom ranking to adapt Algolia to your needs.

text: Rules let you override relevance for specific situations, e.g. seasonal promotions
quote: Use rules to override relevance in some situations. For example, for seasonal product promotions.

text: Typo tolerance is built in and tunable for how fuzzy matching applies
quote: Algolia provides typo tolerance out-of-the-box, along with some important ways to customize just how tolerant a search experience should be.

text: InstantSearch.js is an open-source vanilla JS library for building full search interfaces
quote: InstantSearch.js is an open source UI library for vanilla JS that lets you build a search interface in your frontend app.

text: InstantSearch offers three levels of UI control: predefined widgets, customized widgets, and fully custom widgets
quote: InstantSearch offers three levels of increasing control over your UI: Start with a predefined widget... customize a predefined widget... create a custom widget.

text: RefinementList widget builds faceted filtering (e.g. by brand) from a single query
quote: add the [`refinementList`](/doc/api-reference/widgets/refinement-list/js)` widget and ask it to show a list of brands, so your users can refine their search using those brands.

text: Browse & navigation features support category pages, filtering, and faceted navigation
quote: Browse & Navigation - Category pages, filtering, and faceted navigation

text: Built-in search analytics show popular searches, no-results queries, and click-through rates
quote: Search analytics offer insights into what your users search and which results they select through metrics such as popular searches, no results, and click-through rates.

text: Analytics dashboard supports comparison mode to compare metrics across date ranges
quote: To compare the performance of your metrics between different periods, click **Comparison mode** and select the date ranges you want to compare.

text: Analytics data can be exported and downloaded as CSV or XLSX files
quote: You can export and download your analytics data as CSV or XLSX files.

text: Prebuilt integrations exist for Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, and Zendesk
quote: If your data is in one of these platforms, use an integration: Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, or Zendesk.

text: Crawler extracts content from web pages and turns it into searchable records when no API/DB export exists
quote: If your content is only web pages, and you don't have an API or database export, use the Crawler. The Crawler extracts content from your pages and turns it into records.

text: Crawler MCP tool can crawl web pages or whole sites into a RAG-optimized index
quote: `algolia-crawler` Crawl web pages or whole sites into a RAG-optimized index with the Algolia Crawler

text: Agent Studio connects an LLM to Algolia search/tools and grounds responses in live index data
quote: Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools. It manages the end-to-end workflow and grounds responses in live data from your Algolia indices.

text: Agent Studio can build shopping assistants, content summarizers, and conversational search experiences
quote: Agent Studio lets you create: **Shopping assistants** that answer product questions and recommend items.

text: A/B testing lets you run two search experiences live and compare results
quote: Consider A/B testing to create two alternative search experiences, put them both live and see

text: Official client libraries cover JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, and .NET
quote: Official clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET

text: Migration tool automatically updates API client code to the latest major version across many languages
quote: `algolia-migration` Migrate API client code to the latest major version (JS, Python, Go, PHP, Java, C#, Ruby, Kotlin, Scala, Swift)

text: MCP server exposes search, analytics, and recommendations as agent-callable tools
quote: `algolia-mcp` Search, analytics, and recommendations via the Algolia MCP server

text: Agent skills allow managing search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration via agent tooling
quote: Agent skills for managing Algolia search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration.

text: LLM completions are cached by default to reduce token costs
quote: Completions are cached by default to minimize your LLM provider token costs.

text: Merchandising Studio provides visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting search results
quote: Merchandising Studio - Visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting search results

text: Personalization builds user-level affinity profiles to personalize ranking
quote: Personalization - User-level affinity profiles for personalized ranking

text: Recommend feature provides ML-based product recommendations like frequently-bought-together and trending items
quote: Recommend - ML-based product recommendations (frequently bought together, related items, trending)

text: Service is backed by a 99.999% uptime SLA
quote: SLA (99.999% uptime SLA)

text: AI Search (NeuralSearch) combines keyword and vector semantic search in a hybrid model
quote: AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search

text: High availability is achieved via a documented retry strategy using fallback server URLs
quote: To guarantee high availability, implement a retry strategy for all API requests using the URLs of your servers as fallbacks

text: Dashboard lets you configure scheduled tasks with retries and transformations without deploying code
quote: Algolia keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations. Configure them in the Algolia dashboard without deploying code.

text: The algolia.com site's own content is indexed in Algolia and directly queryable
quote: The algolia.com website content is indexed in Algolia and can be queried directly.

text: Custom widget creation lets you implement UI functionality not covered by predefined widgets
quote: To implement something that doesn't exist, create a **custom widget**.
